serious.shareholderLetter: Management reports a traceable year: income, consumption, refunds, repayment timing, and review items are separated before any narrative is allowed to sound confident.
serious.auditorNote: The report uses cleaned ledger rows. It does not invent balances from transaction exports.

board_roast.shareholderLetter: Management congratulates itself on classification discipline. The board notes that labeling a purchase carefully does not make it strategic.
board_roast.auditorNote: The audit committee found no magic. Repayments are timing, refunds are deductions, and optimism remains unaudited.

social_share.shareholderLetter: My year in money: classified, reconciled, lightly roasted.
